quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova to supply 29.4 MW of wind capacity for Eurus (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova's Onshore Wind business signed an agreement with Eurus Energy Holdings Corporation to supply seven 4.2 MW-117m wind turbines for the 29.4 MW Eurus Hiyamizutouge Wind Farm in Aomori Prefecture, Japan, including a two-year service agreement with an option for a two-year extension. GE Vernova secured 339 MW of orders in Japan in 2025; per the release its technology accounts for around 50% of Japan's installed heavy-duty gas turbine capacity and 25% of its onshore wind capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: seven 4.2 MW turbines, 29.4 MW; 339 MW of Japan orders in 2025
